intro.heading: Get back to what you love, in Newport
paragraphs: A parkrun without the niggle. A full session at your local gym. Keeping up with the kids on the weekend. Whatever you are working towards, our Newport team is here to help you move towards it.
If something keeps returning, our osteopaths take the time to understand the whole picture, provide hands-on care and build a practical plan around your goals.

team.imageAlt: Dr Ashton Wilson at Alpha Sports Medicine
team.heading: More of the right people in one place
paragraphs: Newport is Alpha's largest team. Osteopaths work alongside physiotherapy, chiropractic, dietetics and exercise-led care, making it easier to involve another discipline when it genuinely supports your plan.
Your care is still led by one clear plan, with each recommendation explained along the way.

faqs.question: Do I need a referral or GP care plan?
faqs.answer: No. You can book directly. If you have a GP care plan, WorkCover or TAC claim, let us know when you make your appointment.

faqs.question: Can I claim on private health?
faqs.answer: Most eligible services can be claimed on site. Your rebate depends on your extras cover, so check the details with your health fund.

faqs.question: Which Newport practitioner should I book with?
faqs.answer: Choose the practitioner whose area of interest best matches your needs, or call our team and we can help point you in the right direction.

faqs.question: Can I see an osteopath and physiotherapist at the same clinic?
faqs.answer: Yes. Newport brings several disciplines together, so care can be coordinated when another perspective would support your plan.

faqs.question: Is the clinic close to public transport?
faqs.answer: The clinic is a short walk from Newport Station, served by the Werribee and Williamstown lines.

closing.heading: Book at Newport
closing.copy: Book with one of our Newport practitioners, or call and we will help you find the right person.
